title: The tool's own checker on the Quorum and Crosscut property contracts: --engine auto against JBMC
description: Runs both modules' properties.contract with jvmcontract prove --engine auto (the tool's own bounded model checker where the property is over integers, JBMC elsewhere) and again with --engine jbmc, and compares the verdicts property by property: they must all be verified under both, as the verify scripts record. The auto run's JSON says which properties the native engine decided (the proof line names 'jvmcontract's own checker (CaDiCaL)') and which went to JBMC with a note, and how long each took; that is the evidence for making auto the default later.
expected: the compare step prints 'quorum 5 properties agree' and 'crosscut 7 properties agree' with a count of those the native engine decided; exits 0

resources.notes: JBMC proves Quorum's five in about four seconds and Crosscut's seven in about forty; the native engine is quicker on what it takes

steps.name: compile quorum
steps.run: cd examples/apps/quorum && rm -rf build && javac -parameters -g -proc:none -d build/main $(find src/main/java -name '*.java')

steps.name: compile crosscut
steps.run: cd examples/apps/crosscut && rm -rf build && javac -parameters -g -proc:none -d build/main $(find src/main/java -name '*.java')

steps.name: quorum, both engines
steps.run: cd examples/apps/quorum && jvmcontract prove --properties src/contract/properties.contract --classes build/main --engine auto --json > ../../../verification/.engines-quorum-auto.json; jvmcontract prove --properties src/contract/properties.contract --classes build/main --engine jbmc --json > ../../../verification/.engines-quorum-jbmc.json

steps.name: crosscut, both engines
steps.run: cd examples/apps/crosscut && jvmcontract prove --properties src/contract/properties.contract --classes build/main --engine auto --json > ../../../verification/.engines-crosscut-auto.json; jvmcontract prove --properties src/contract/properties.contract --classes build/main --engine jbmc --json > ../../../verification/.engines-crosscut-jbmc.json

steps.name: compare
steps.run:
python3 -c "
import json
for app in ['quorum', 'crosscut']:
    a = json.load(open(f'verification/.engines-{app}-auto.json')); j = json.load(open(f'verification/.engines-{app}-jbmc.json'))
    outs = lambda d: d if isinstance(d, list) else d.get('outcomes', d.get('results', [d]))
    pa, pj = {o['target']: o for o in outs(a)}, {o['target']: o for o in outs(j)}
    assert pa.keys() == pj.keys(), (pa.keys(), pj.keys())
    native = 0
    for t in pa:
        assert pa[t]['verdict'] == pj[t]['verdict'] == 'verified', (t, pa[t].get('verdict'), pj[t].get('verdict'), pa[t].get('problem'))
        native += 'own checker' in (pa[t].get('proof') or '')
    print(app, len(pa), 'properties agree;', native, 'decided by the tool\'s own checker')
"
